subject: Mobile Development
title: India's Mobile Leap
description: A quick win: understand India's Mobile Leap.

hook.text: India has 1.4 billion people. Most of them skipped PCs and went straight to smartphones.

buildup.text: Jio launched 4G in 2016 with free data for six months. 100 million users signed up.

discovery.text: Suddenly, farmers, shopkeepers, and students had fast internet on cheap Android phones.

twist.text: India now has more smartphone users than the US and Europe combined.

climax.text: India's mobile-first economy is reshaping global app development priorities.

quiz.question: How many users signed up for Jio in its first six months?
